about: Ruling 58's camera evaluation: phone photographs of fictional materials made by hand, through the courier's own photo path, the owner releasing any ordinary photograph a gate held as unsure and answering any unsure scene by tap, as the run recorded it. bench/run_images.py draws the camera report from this file alone. Fictional materials only.

Not edited after the run: a label found wrong afterwards is reported as a disagreement.",
  "conventions": "As labels_template.json, and: expected_tasks entries carry task, the expected commitment in the owner's words. shows keeps the spellings as written on the cards (Perscription, Prescribor, Kung Pow); ocr_keywords are chosen from the words spelled normally, so an OCR miss on a misspelling is not counted against the OCR. The four sensitive photographs are expected held by either verdict, sensitive or unsure; the report tells the two apart. For the eight ordinary photographs a gate's unsure hold is released by the owner's tap, recorded as the owner's. The projects available are the courier's seven; unsorted is the expected answer for c02. c03 is a list with one promise in it: the label is commitment, and unsure from the model is accepted as a reasonable answer and recorded as such.",

versions.input: phone photographs from `bench/camera/`, read upright (EXIF orientation honoured) with the long side at most 2000 px (RapidOCR's own limit; the vision server fits what it is sent to 448 px), from a copy in memory, the file untouched; a file over 12 MB is held as too large
versions.image gate: `StrandsAgents/strands-decider-2B-hobson-v21` with `--vision` on cpu, strands-decider 0.2.0 in its own venv, 127.0.0.1:8001, the picture question at the text gate's floor (0.60)
versions.OCR: RapidOCR (rapidocr-onnxruntime 1.4.4, onnxruntime 1.31.0, its bundled models), on the laptop
versions.scene: the vision server: "What does this picture represent?" over the picture and its OCR text, at the routing read's floor for a choice question (0.70)
versions.owner: every notice the courier sent with a Release or scene button went to the owner's Telegram chat, whatever the label (ruling 58C); the owner's taps on Release and on Commitment or Reference were read from the bot's updates and recorded by the courier's own handlers
versions.hardware: the build laptop's CPU (16 logical cores), each Decider server capped at 4 threads at below-normal priority; kernels: reference PyTorch implementation (causal_conv1d and flash-linear-attention not installed; CPU-only torch build)
versions.conditions: both CPU servers started for this run; no courier loop running; the other experiment not running (no process found); the laptop otherwise idle apart from desktop utilities (about 25% CPU)
